title: Wrapping an Agent Loop for Token Counting
description: A drop-in chat helper that counts every model call by wrapping the inner call once per agent, so the existing loop needs no change.

steps.description: The script imports `metered`, `ollama_chat`, and `summarize` from `token_usage`. It wraps the inner call once per agent: `planner_call` and `critic_call`. Each agent's tokens land in the CSV under its own name.
`chat` is a drop-in replacement for the course helper: same arguments, same return value. It calls the wrapped `call` and returns the message content as text.
`plan` is one `chat` call on the default planner. `review` passes `call=critic_call`, so that call is counted under the critic.
`summarize()` ends the run with a per-agent table and a run total.

steps.question: The page says running the script three times leaves three runs in the CSV, separated by what?
